translations.web: He followed her immediately, as an ox goes to the slaughter, as a fool stepping into a noose.
translations.bsb: He follows her on impulse, like an ox going to the slaughter, like a deer bounding into a trap,
translations.kjv: He goeth after her straightway, as an ox goeth to the slaughter, or as a fool to the correction of the stocks;
translations.asv: He goeth after her straightway, As an ox goeth to the slaughter, Or as one in fetters to the correction of the fool;
